name: Main Process
description: Electron main process entry — creates frameless BrowserWindow (1440x900, maximized, contextIsolation=true, sandbox=true), registers all IPC handlers for filesystem operations (with path security — isPathSafe restricts operations to workspace subtree), PTY terminal sessions (platform-aware shell selection: COMSPEC on Windows, /bin/zsh on Darwin, /bin/bash on Linux), chokidar file watching (debounced 100ms, ignores .git/node_modules), workspace persistence (last-workspace.txt, recent-workspaces.json in userData, .cockpit/window.json per workspace), window controls (minimize/maximize/close/isMaximized/new, multi-window support with per-window workspace tracking), clipboard operations, user preferences (preferences.json in userData), shell.openExternal with URL protocol validation, native directory picker, and git operations via child_process.execFile. IDE server lifecycle is tied to workspace: started on workspace select/setPath, stopped on close. Environment filtering for PTY spawns (ALLOWED_ENV_KEYS only). Terminal cleanup on window close. Multi-window terminal session tracking via terminalSenders Map.

dependencies.usage: IDE context server started/stopped on workspace open/close

events: terminal:data (webContents.send — sent from PTY onData callback)
terminal:exit (webContents.send — sent from PTY onExit callback)
file:changed (webContents.send — debounced 100ms via chokidar batched queue)

security.isPathSafe: Resolves both target and real paths, checks they start with workspace path + separator (case-insensitive on win32) — restricts all fs:* operations to workspace subtree
security.urlProtocolValidation: shell:openExternal only allows https:, http:, mailto: protocols via URL constructor check
security.sandbox: BrowserWindow sandbox=true — renderer has no Node.js access
security.contextIsolation: contextIsolation=true — renderer accesses only contextBridge-exposed API
security.csp: Content Security Policy enforced in index.html
security.nodeIntegration: false — renderer cannot access Node.js APIs
security.devTools: Disabled in packaged builds (only enabled when not app.isPackaged or --dev flag)
security.zoomLock: Ctrl+/-/= prevented via before-input-event to block browser zoom; setVisualZoomLevelLimits(1,1)
security.navigation: will-navigate defaultPrevented, windowOpenHandler denies all new windows
security.filterEnv: Only ALLOWED_ENV_KEYS (PATH, HOME, SHELL, COMSPEC, TEMP, etc.) passed to PTY env — prevents credential leakage

methods.name: _testSetWorkspacePath
methods.description: Test helper — sets defaultWorkspacePath for unit test isolation

methods.name: _testIsPathSafe
methods.description: Test helper — exposes isPathSafe check for unit test verification

lifecycle.created_by: Electron app.whenReady() — creates main BrowserWindow, registers all IPC handlers, starts file watcher and IDE server if CLI workspace path provided
lifecycle.destroyed_by: app.on('window-all-closed') — stops IDE server, stops file watcher, kills all PTY processes, clears terminal maps, quits (except macOS)
